overview: This file documents the diplomatic commemoration of American relief following the 1923 Great Kantō Earthquake, focusing on the completion of Tokyo and Yokohama’s reconstruction and the 1930 United States tour of the Jiji Shimpo’s women “Envoys of Gratitude.” Its correspondence, press materials, biographies, itineraries, and official messages trace the mission’s planning, immigration and customs arrangements, civic and charitable visits, and receptions by President and Mrs. Hoover and Calvin and Grace Coolidge. Later documents concern the 1935 memorial service for earthquake victims and the proposed publication of historical correspondence from the earthquake file.
interest: Earthquake aid becoming diplomatic memory: young women envoys' selection, itinerary and receptions, and later memorials and publications.
